content:
All four facing tiles are empty. The notice board is on my own tile and not interactable from any facing direction.

Let me reconsider the fundamental issue. The pathfinder said the notice board is "in the way" at (2,7). This means the game's collision grid marks (2,7) as blocked. I'm standing on a blocked tile. 

But the map shows '@' at (2,7) — the map draws me there regardless of collision. So I spawned on a blocked tile.

Is there ANY way to move off a blocked tile? In many games, you can move off a solid tile if the destination is free. But here all 4 destinations report "blocked". That's the puzzle — maybe the destinations are ALSO blocked in the collision grid even though the map shows '.'.

Wait — the map legend: '.' walkable, '#' blocked, '~' water, 'W' warp, 'D' door. The map shows '.' around me. But the game says blocked. Contradiction between map and collision.

Unless the map is showing a DIFFERENT layer. Let me reconsider: maybe the notice board is a 3x3 blocking object centered at (2,7), so (1,6),(2,6),(3,6),(1,7),(2,7),(3,7),(1,8),(2,8),(3,8) are all blocked by it. That would explain all 4 directions blocked! And the map only shows 'o' for the center but the collision is larger.

If that's the case, I'm trapped in the center of a 3x3 solid notice board. That's a hard soft-lock with no escape via movement.

But wait — the player Tester is at (3,7), which would be inside the 3x3 too, yet the player is a separate entity. Hmm.

Let me reconsider: maybe the notice board is 1 tile at (2,7) and the player at (3,7) is fine. My 4 directions blocked could be because... (2,6) is blocked by something, (3,7) by player, (2,8) blocked, (1,7) blocked. But map shows all '.'.

I think the most likely explanation: I'm soft-locked on the notice board. But the task expects me to complete it, so there must be a way.

Let me try pressing KeyE to "read the notice" — maybe the game has a special case: pressing E while ON the notice board reads it. But it checks facing tile. 

Let me try pressing KeyC or other keys. Actually, let me try pressing KeyE with NO movement first (just E) — maybe the game reads the notice on my tile when I press E without a facing target. But facing is always set.

Let me try a fresh approach: maybe the game engine's movement is fine but there's a "stuck" flag. Let me try pressing KeyE to open a panel (the task mentions "open panels"). Maybe there's a panel that lets me teleport or reset.
